images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — SCENE PLATE for an in-scene register test. An interior: the Keepers' archive hall — a worn grey flagstone floor filling most of the frame, a low stone plinth with stacked ledgers and a brass hour-glass at the upper-left, a dark wooden shelf of scroll-tubes along the far wall at the top edge, a few fallen pages and a coil of rope on the floor, deep shadowed alcoves. Elevated three-quarter camera (projection C, the ARPG camera): the floor is the play surface and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, the far wall the upper third; NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D — bold inked contour of even, heavy weight around the silhouette with thinner interior lines, cel-style two-tone shading with painterly texture inside the flats, strong graphic silhouette; a frame that could sit inside a hand-animated cycle with slight drawing variation between frames. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black; no spell glow. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette.

concerns: Followed the task's verbatim H2 scene description; its shading, full-scene background and landscape dimensions conflict with the frozen register's style, green plate and sprite-sheet constraints.
Generated pages contain writing-like marks despite the no-text instruction.
The upper-left key appears warm; surface texture is pronounced and shading is not strictly two-tone.
Exact projection C constants were unavailable within the supplied references.
